question: PQR is a triangle. The bisectors of the internal angle ∠Q and external angle ∠R intersect at S. If ∠QSR = 40°, then ∠P is:
solution:
Given

∠QSR = 40°

Concept

Exterior angle property of a triangle i.e exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of interior opposite angle of a triangle.

Calculation

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/621eb77ed7ead4d391a9907caf047eaf7ff924a11ef0bcb82eead37ef3905909.png] 

In ∆PQR

∠PRT = ∠PQR + ∠QPR (exterior angle property of a triangle)

2b = 2a + ∠QPR ---- (1)

In ∆SRT

∠SRT = ∠SQR + ∠QSR(exterior angle property)

b = a + 40 --- (2)

put value of 2 in equation 1

2(a + 40) = 2a + ∠QPR

⇒ 2a + 80° = 2a + ∠QPR

⇒ 80° = ∠QPR

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
